purpose: Cubic-system mechanical stability criteria (Born stability conditions), used to judge whether the Fe–Mn–Al alloys are mechanically stable based on their elastic constants.
applicability_conditions: Cubic crystal system; applied to the Fe1-xMnxAl alloy system.

symbols.meaning: Elastic constant (one of the three independent elastic constants of the cubic crystal)
